This page contains a list of things which need to be done. Also check out the categories in this page.

{| class="valign-top" style="min-width: 60%; max-width: 75%"
|
=== Help Others ===

* Deal with [[:Category:To-do|To-do]] articles
* Process [[:Category:WIP|WIP]] (be sure not to interfere with another author!)
* Clarify information in [[:Category:Clarification needed|Clarification needed pages]]
* Check [[Special:WantedPages|Wanted Pages]]

=== Expand Content ===

* [[:Category:Stubs|Stubs pages]] or remove the {{hl|<nowiki>{{Stub}}</nowiki>}} marker
* [[:Category:Maintenance/RV|RV missing info pages]] (see side table)
|
=== General Maintenance ===

* Fix [[:Category:Pages with wrong Enfusion classes|Pages with wrong Enfusion classes]] ({{Name|enfusion}} titles)
* Add command group categories to [[:Category:Command Group: Uncategorised|Uncategorised Commands]]
* Add function group categories to [[:Category:Function Group: Uncategorised|Uncategorised Functions]]
* Fix or remove dead image links in [[:Category:Pages with broken file links|Broken Links pages]]
* Merge pages in [[:Category:Merge Requests|Merge Requests]]
* Check the [[:Category:To-do|To-do]] category for pages that are on the to-do list
* See if anything needs attention in the [[Special:TrackingCategories|Tracking Categories]].
* Resolve [[Special:DoubleRedirects|double]] and [[Special:BrokenRedirects|broken]] redirects

<!--
* Finally, don't forget to blame [[User:Lou_Montana|Lou Montana]] for any inaccuracies ;)<br> muh!
-->
|}
